newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends down on commercials, spreads, CBOT.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends down on commercials, spreads, CBOT.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended down on commercial hedges, spreads and CBOT soybeans, traders said.

"UGG sold 50 to 75 Jan on hedges, Cargill sold 50 Jan and 50 March MOC (market on close), 300 Jan-March spread and that's a big part of the volume, Chicago's down," a trader said. Jan-Mar spread at $2.70, May-Nov $30, Nov-Jan $4, Mar May $2.50. November crush margin traded up to -24.14 from Wednesday's close at -25.08.
January canola was down $0.70 at $392.80, March fell $0.50 to $395.70. January flax rose $0.50 to $360.50 on commercial demand and active spreading. Nov-Jan spread at $1.
UGG bought 100 December feed peas down US$0.50 to US$195 from commercials, traders said. Volume was 183 lots.
Western barley futures and domestic feed wheat fell ahead of the Remembrance Day long weekend and in anticipation of the USDA's crop output report Nov 12. The WCE is closed on Monday.
February western barley fell $0.50 at $138.80, March lost $0.30 to $139.10. Feb-May spread $2, Nov-Feb $5. Volume 600.
December wheat lost $0.40 at $163.70 with Alberta Wheat Pool selling, March lost $0.10 to $164.20, traders said. Dec Mar spread at even money. Volume was 1,370 lots.
(All values in Canadian dollars except peas, oats).
